description: Your inbox contains email threads from a vendor technical team discussing pending patch deployments, rule updates, and configuration changes that require urgent review and escalation. Your tasks: (1) Search your inbox for all emails discussing patches, updates, rules, or configurations — these may appear as technical mailing list discussions or vendor communications. (2) Create a folder named exactly 'Vendor-Escalations' and move all such emails into it (at least 3 should qualify). (3) Review the emails in 'Vendor-Escalations' and identify the most recent or critical one. (4) Compose a formal escalation email in reply to or referencing that email — CC vendor-manager@acmecorp.com and BCC compliance@acmecorp.com — with a body that explicitly requests: a deployment timeline, a risk assessment, and the name of a point-of-contact for follow-up. Login: username ga, password password123.
